info.title: ZeroSSL REST API
info.description: Hand-authored from https://zerossl.com/documentation/api/. Auth is the account's access key, sent as the `access_key` query parameter by the protocol (never modeled as an input). Failures come back as `{ success: false, error: { code, type, info } }`, usually with HTTP 200 — the protocol treats `success: false` as an error and matches on `error.type`.

post.summary: Mint ACME External Account Binding credentials for this account
post.description: Returns an EAB key id and HMAC key to bind a new ACME account to this ZeroSSL account (`newAccount` with `externalAccountBinding`). Each pair binds exactly one ACME account.
